verdict.rationale: Claude Design can apply a team's existing design system automatically and offers sliders for tuning spacing/color, and one community report describes generating reusable design system tokens via a PenPot MCP integration, but there's no first-party documentation of native token/variable management with mode/theme switching across designs. Missing for 10: dedicated token/variable editor, explicit mode/theme switching UI, and first-party (non-third-party-MCP) evidence of token systems.
